description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'PayGradeCurrencyAPI' within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class provides CRUD operations for managing the association between pay grades and currencies, including retrieving single and multiple currency records, creating, updating, and deleting pay grade currencies. It leverages Doctrine ORM entities, validation rules, and OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrencyAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing CRUD operations for PayGradeCurrency entities, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion, with validation and OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific PayGradeCurrency record by payGradeId and currencyId, throwing a RecordNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of all PayGradeCurrency records for a specific payGradeId, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new PayGradeCurrency record based on request data, returning the created model.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing PayGradeCurrency record based on provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified PayGradeCurrency records for a given payGradeId and list of currency IDs.

methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' method parameters.

methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' method parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new PayGradeCurrency.

methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an existing PayGradeCurrency.

methods.description: Handles creation or updating of a PayGradeCurrency entity based on request data, including validation and entity retrieval.
